WTO | Dispute settlement - Index of disputes issues
the subjects of WTO disputes. Because there are often a number of ways
to describe an issue, each dispute can appear under more than one
heading. The issues are broadly classified under goods, intellectual   property and services.
This summary has been prepared by the Secretariat under its own responsibility. The summary is for general information only and is not intended to affect the rights and obligations of Members.
